title: Hooded figures spraying plague from landed craft

tellings.quote: that Braramley did is that he found that the plague broke out only after these people would land in the fields, come out of these objects, land in, and they would go around with these hoods on and these spray cans that became the basis for the sid and the grim reaper image.

plain: In medieval Europe, outbreaks of plague are said to have begun only after hooded figures landed in the fields in strange objects, stepped out, and walked around with what looked like spray cans, and this sight is said to be where the image of the Grim Reaper with his scythe comes from. A researcher named Jason Jorjani tells this from the work of an author named William Bramley, who wrote the book The Gods of Eden. If true, it would mean the plague was spread on purpose by visitors from elsewhere.
